remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. From Ghost Ranch, New Mexico, 1937. See gallery photograph" [not verified]. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication dates work as 1937, American Museum of Western Art dates as 1935 based on Joan Carpenter Troccoli, *Painters and the American West, Volume II* (Denver: American Museum of Western Art, 2013), p. 260 and A Collection of Drawings & Watercolors by Charles Demuth: American 19th and 20th Century Paintings, Drawings, Watercolors & Sculpture Thursday, October 28th, 1976 at 11 a.m. & 2 p.m. (New York: Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., 1976), lot 183.] (Source:  Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by American Museum of Western Art, 2025)

description: Rolling, bright red hills fill the frame. Two large hills rise on the right and left side of the composition, with an arching, river-like strip of dark red flowing between the two. On the leftmost hill, craggy arroyos run through its smooth surface. A soft, cream-colored sky stretches above the landscape.
